note: The skill path of every military career of careers.json, by title: its skills by their catalogue names (data/skills/catalogue.json), and `basis`, where the path was read from. A path names skills and sets no level. One path was read against its official task list (Navy Hull Maintenance Technician); the rest were drafted from each job's title and published scope, and every one loads as a draft for a person to approve. scripts/build-military-sql.mjs checks this file and generates the migration (0064).
